feeds.title: Arctic News
feeds.description: The Arctic-News Blog describes the situation in the Arctic, focusing especially on the threat of large abrupt methane eruptions from the Arctic Ocean seafloor. Contributors to the blog share a deep concern about the way climate change is unfolding in the Arctic and the threat that this poses for the world at large.
